question: Identify the organism that shows bioluminescence.
solution:
The correct answer is** Ctenoplana**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Comb Jelly:** Ctenoplana is a genus of comb jellies, marine invertebrates known for their iridescent beauty.
 
• **Bioluminescent Property:** Many species of Ctenoplana are capable of producing bioluminescence, emitting light through chemical reactions within their bodies.
 
• **Purpose of Bioluminescence:** Bioluminescence serves various purposes in Ctenoplana, including attracting prey, deterring predators, and communicating with other individuals.
 
• **Unique Bioluminescent Patterns:** The patterns and colors of bioluminescence in Ctenoplana can vary widely, adding to their captivating appearance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tapeworm:** Tapeworms are parasitic flatworms that infect the intestines of animals. 
 
• **Liver fluke:** Liver flukes are parasitic flatworms that infect the liver of animals. 
 
• **Fasciola:** Fasciola is a genus of parasitic flatworms that infect the liver and bile ducts of animals.
